cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

mechanism: Copy a shopping receipt as the authoritative form for a friendly umbrella loan, then revise its terms under the borrower's pressure.
confusable: Not merely a deliberately legalistic friend: B2 must identify the copied ticket as a completed-sale receipt, not a permission form.
comparison: A rain-and-bus deadline creates urgency rather than the wedding scene's emotional support.
seedUse: Retains umbrella loan, urgency and signature from the canonical Drive; bakery receipt is a new S04 misunderstanding.
